# Nima Maghame

Design Manager and Creative Leader
Los Angeles, California

Nima Maghame is a design manager and creative leader with over 15 years of experience across presentation design, branding, web design, UI/UX, front-end development, and AI-assisted workflow design. His work combines creative leadership, technical curiosity, operational thinking, and hands-on execution.

## Current Positioning

Nima combines design leadership, technical curiosity, and operational thinking to build systems, workflows, and digital experiences that improve both creative quality and team efficiency. He is strongest where creative direction, team leadership, workflow design, and hands-on making overlap.

## Professional Experience

- Houlihan Lokey, 2017-Present: Design Manager in Los Angeles. Nima now runs the LA office presentation design team after growing from leading the night team into a broader office-wide leadership role. He oversees creative quality, mentorship, workflow coordination, training, and process improvement for confidential, deadline-driven presentation work.
- Results and operational proof: Supports 200-400 requests per month across regions while maintaining high standards for client-ready design. Built PNGMapper, a custom tool that turned 1,000-plus point map jobs from hours of manual work into minutes.
